items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Marks / Diagnostics

*   [markgandolfo/dartboard.nvim (⭐15)](https://github.com/markgandolfo/dartboard.nvim) - Mark files and quickly access them, inspired by Harpoon and Lasso.

### Tree-sitter Supported Colorscheme / Diagnostics

*   [pmouraguedes/neodarcula.nvim (⭐9)](https://github.com/pmouraguedes/neodarcula.nvim) - A dark theme with support for transparency, dimming, LSP semantic tokens and more.

### Utility / Diagnostics

*   [gpanders/nvim-moonwalk (⭐76)](https://github.com/gpanders/nvim-moonwalk) - Use any language that compiles to Lua anywhere in your Neovim configuration.
*   [markgandolfo/lightswitch.nvim (⭐17)](https://github.com/markgandolfo/lightswitch.nvim) - Toggle various options using the `nui.nvim` library.

### Neovim Lua Development / Diagnostics

*   [chrisgve/databox.nvim (⭐12)](https://github.com/chrisgve/databox.nvim) - Encrypted storage for Lua tables using [age (⭐20k)](https://github.com/FiloSottile/age) or compatible encryption tools for cryptographic safety.
*   [BirdeeHub/lze (⭐76)](https://github.com/BirdeeHub/lze) - A lazy-loading library for Neovim plugins.
*   [lumen-oss/lz.n (⭐213)](https://github.com/lumen-oss/lz.n) - A simple lazy loading library for Neovim plugins.

### GitHub / Diagnostics

*   [cd-4/git-needy.nvim (⭐2)](https://github.com/cd-4/git-needy.nvim) - Keeps a tally of workflows that need to be reviewed in your statusbar.
